notes: Every network's tokens in one list: each one's newest finished read of its most-traded pools, grouped by token on that chain — the same token on two chains is two rows, each naming its chain.
Highest and lowest are within these lists — never a whole chain's.
"thin": under $10,000 of liquidity. "wash": 24 h volume over 100 times its liquidity.
Read: Robinhood Chain, 40 pools at 2026-10-26 18:00 UTC (its 200 most-traded at most, read every 10 minutes); Ethereum, 20 pools at 2026-10-26 18:00 UTC (its 60 most-traded at most, read hourly).
The networks are read at different times: every figure carries the time its own network was read.

Not read yet: Solana (read hourly), Base (read hourly), BSC (read hourly), Arbitrum (read hourly), Polygon (read hourly), Avalanche (read hourly), OP Mainnet (read hourly) — named here rather than left out; each joins the list once a read of its pools has finished.
